newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX off after volatility, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX off after volatility, seen rangebound.

text.p: Austrian shares ended just off on Tuesday after a volatile session and traders predicted the index would remain rangebound between 1,260 and 1,300 points over the next few days.
The ATX blue chip index shed 1.53 points, or 0.12 percent, to end at 1,298.82. Six shares rose, 12 fell and three were unchanged.
"The air is thin at this level. No one wants to take any big risks at this level any longer," said one trader.
"We will see several more similar rollercoaster sessions in the near future," another forecast.

Oil and chemicals group OMV ended at 1,583 schillings, having swung between 1,560 and 1,613 during the session. Likewise regional utility EVN fluctuated between 1,711 and 1,780 before climbing back down to end at 1,712.45.
Fireproof materials maker Radex Heraklith led the decliners, slipping 1.49 percent to 512 schillings.
The leading gainer was high-grade steelmaker Boehler, adding 2.6 percent to finish at 946 schillings.
The June ATX future dropped 5.8 points to 1,295.5 on turnover of 738 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
